Name: Boggy Hospital
Author: mossiegoat
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Already have all of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch[/url]'s mods and feel like Pelican Town isn't boggy enough? Do none of the interior mods feel right? This mod is for you. 
This one is ONLY the hospital and Harvey's room. More coming at some point
Looks best with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url] - makes the blue curtains purple[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790][/url]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the mod[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]2. Extract the mod[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]3. Move the mod into your mod folder[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bog's Witchy Tilesheets - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43167]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43167[/url][/color]
DaisyNiko's Tilesheets - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]BogWyytch, Abagaianye[/color] and DaisyNiko for being awesome and inspiring me
